newsitem.title: FRANCE: Worms reflects on Athena's future.
newsitem.headline: Worms reflects on Athena's future.

text.p: Worms et Cie, which announced on Friday a merger with Saint-Louis, said on Monday it was engaged in "deep" reflection about the future of its insurance unit Athena.
Since insurer Axa combined last year with rival UAP, seen as signalling the start of a major restructuring in the sector, the market has speculated that Worms might sell Athena.

"We are obliged to take into account that the world is changing very quickly, that there is major restructuring under way. We have been engaged in deep strategic reflection (about Athena for some time," Worms chairman Jean-Philippe Thierry told a news conference.

French insurer AGF is often cited as a potential bidder and analysts say it could help it build critical mass in the face of giant Axa-UAP. Last week, however, AGF denied it was interested in Athena. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
